title: ❌ MISDIAGNOSED — The key was never corrupted with trailing `}`. P0 APPEND-ONLY MEMORY NOT ENFORCED ON FRESH INSTALLS — migration 017 triggers silently dropped by filterForSQLite. Dogfood run 2026-08-04: fresh `consensus init` + `serve` on scratch SQLite; direct `UPDATE memory_events SET content='HACKED'` SUCCEEDED; 0 triggers in sqlite_master; schema_versions records v17 'append only memory events sqlite triggers' as applied (checksum 2cd). Root cause: filterForSQLite (internal/migrate/migrate.go) enters mTrigger skip-mode on the FIRST line of any CREATE TRIGGER that lacks ' BEGIN ' on that line, then drops every line incl. the closing one — the whole statement vanishes, runner records success. The keep-check `strings.Contains(upper, " BEGIN ")` only inspects the header line, which never contains BEGIN for multi-line triggers. README headline claim ('append-only ledger enforced by database triggers'; demo 'UPDATE attempt → 500') is FALSE on real instances; an agent with the SQL tool can rewrite its own audit trail. Postgres side also unimplemented (018 comment: 'separate task'). FIX: pass *_sqlite_* trigger files through untouched or detect BEGIN..END across lines; add post-init assertion test that triggers exist; add startup repair like repairTrustLevel.
worker_summary: fb076fe — skip PG->SQLite filter for *_sqlite_* migrations + triggerIsSQLiteStyle multi-line detection + repairAppendOnlyTriggers heal; regression test incl. heal path (migrate_test.go). Judge PASS (dogfood-94).
